title: RAG Chatbot
tagline: Production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation system with hybrid search and evaluation
description: Enterprise RAG platform supporting multiple document types (PDF, Notion, Confluence, GitHub, Slack), hybrid search (dense + sparse + keyword), re-ranking, query rewriting, and automated evaluation pipeline. Handles 10M+ documents with sub-second latency.
problem: Naive RAG fails on: domain-specific terminology, table/chart extraction, conflicting sources, stale data, and hallucination. Enterprise needs: access control, audit trails, cost tracking, and measurable quality.
solution: Modular pipeline: 1) Ingestion: Unstructured.io for parsing → chunking (semantic + fixed) → metadata extraction, 2) Embedding: Mixed embedding models (BGE-large + domain-adapted), 3) Index: Pinecone hybrid (dense + BM25), 4) Retrieval: Query rewriting (HyDE) → hybrid search → cross-encoder re-rank → MMR diversification, 5) Generation: GPT-4 with citation prompt + guardrails, 6) Eval: RAGAS + custom golden set → CI/CD gate.
architecture: Microservices (Docker/K8s): Ingestion Workers (Celery+Redis) → Embedding Service (GPU batch) → Pinecone → API Gateway (FastAPI) → LLM Gateway (cost routing) → PostgreSQL (audit/metrics) → Grafana. Multi-tenant with row-level security.
